newsitem.title: FRANCE: France Telecom sees many rivals - paper.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom sees many rivals - paper.

text.p: France Telecom expects to have three main rivals in the French market when the sector opens for full competition in 1998, chairman Michel Bon told the La Tribune newspaper in an interview.

"Those who think that there will be a duopoly, or an oligopoly with three, are mistaken. We will see, in 1998, a number of groups that will compete with France Telecom in all fields. They will all be foreign, without exception, but with French partners," he said.
"The first of these all-out competitors have already been announced -- British Telecom Plc with Generale des Eaux, STET with Bouygues, and some Americans. AT & T will probably be there," Bon said.
He added that there would also be a large number of rival companies who would compete on specific market segments.
